name: openBottomSheet
description: Presents a bottom-sheet page and waits for its result.

typeParameters.name: P
typeParameters.description: The parameter object type of the target route; each field of `params` is checked against the route parameter of the same name (SCH-025).

typeParameters.name: R
typeParameters.description: The result type the presented page returns with pop.

inputs.name: dismissible
inputs.description: Whether dragging down or tapping outside closes the sheet.
